DataShape.name: ParlerConversationHistory
DataShape.description: Stream-backed message history; InfoTable row shape for Parler mashups

FieldDefinition.name: streamSource
FieldDefinition.description: Stream entry source (conversation Thing name, AgentThread id, or adhoc key)

FieldDefinition.name: content
FieldDefinition.description: Message body; empty when assistant row is tool_calls only

FieldDefinition.name: toolCalls
FieldDefinition.description: JSON array of tool calls when role=assistant with tool_calls

FieldDefinition.name: promptTokens
FieldDefinition.description: LLM prompt tokens for this row’s assistant round

FieldDefinition.name: completionTokens
FieldDefinition.description: LLM completion tokens for this row’s assistant round

FieldDefinition.name: llmUsageJson
FieldDefinition.description: Compact provider usage JSON for assistant rows; empty for user/tool
